lcc_original: 亞當一百三十歲的時候，生了一個兒子，生來就有自己的樣式、自己的形像；亞當給他起名叫塞特。
notes: 活到 (WH02421+WTH8799, 'lived') has no explicit lexical equivalent in LCC's age construction '一百三十歲的時候'; marked implicit with braces since the verb is structurally absent in LCC.
LCC reverses the Hebrew/UNV word order: 樣式 (WH01823, dəmût) precedes 形像 (WH06754, ṣelem) in LCC, whereas UNV has 形像 before 樣式. SNs attached to the corresponding words in LCC's order.
The second 亞當 in LCC's name-giving clause ('亞當給他起名叫塞特') is a Chinese explicit subject restatement; Hebrew implies the subject pronominally here, so left untagged.
生來就有自己的 is LCC's restructuring of the pronominal suffixes on 樣式/形像 plus UNV's explanatory '和自己相似'; left untagged as it has no direct SN correspondence.
叫 in '起名叫塞特' is a Chinese verb-complement introducing the name with no Hebrew lexeme; left untagged. WH08352 attaches to 塞特 (the proper name שֵׁת) only.
